scripts.audio: node scripts/make-audio.mjs && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i public/audio/bed.wav -af loudnorm=I=-18:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 44100 public/audio/bed-norm.wav && mv public/audio/bed-norm.wav public/audio/bed.wav && echo "✓ bed.wav выровнен по громкости (-18 LUFS)"
scripts.render: remotion render Promo --timeout=180000 --concurrency=2 out/promo-16x9-raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/promo-16x9-raw.mp4 -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest out/promo-16x9.mp4 && rm out/promo-16x9-raw.mp4 && echo "✓ out/promo-16x9.mp4 (мастеринг -16 LUFS)"
scripts.render:en: remotion render PromoEn --timeout=180000 --concurrency=2 out/promo-16x9-en-raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/promo-16x9-en-raw.mp4 -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest out/promo-16x9-en.mp4 && rm out/promo-16x9-en-raw.mp4 && echo "✓ out/promo-16x9-en.mp4 (мастеринг -16 LUFS)"
